comment: Output index 8 is declared in the header as a test output but its configOutput call is commented out (Imagine.cpp:85) and it has no jack on the panel, so it gets no line and no tag. The manual says the Polarity switch puts the v output at -5V to +5V; the code (Imagine.cpp:396) subtracts 0.5 from a value already scaled 0 to 10, so bipolar gives -0.5V to 9.5V. The g/t knob runs 0 to 1 while the spread it is compared against is taken from voltages scaled 0 to 10 (Imagine.cpp:383-386), so only the lowest tenth of the knob's travel has any effect above zero.
